'''Garrus Tharydine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who oversaw the occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. It was Tharydine who carried out the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] orders to destroy three [[City/Legends|cities]] floating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface when local resistance was formed on the planet. Instead of destroying the [[Mon Calamari Resistance]], it gave Dac's population a reason for [[Calamarian Revolt|open revolt]] and eventually resulted in the liberation of the planet from the oppression of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
